text:
Alex R: quick thread - pick one canonical usage event shape: raw_usage vs billing_ready. need clear rules for corrections/backfills
Priya M: raw_usage should be append-only and immutable. billing_ready is derived and may carry adjustments. downstream ledger expects idempotent charge records
Jonah L: agree. propose two event types: raw_usage (immutable + provenance pointer) and billing_adjustment (references raw_usage.fingerprint, applies delta)
Tessa N: dedupe: client_request_id is flaky. suggest edge_fingerprint = HMAC(tenant_key, client_request_id||model||req_ts_floor) generated at ingress
Alex R: include ingest_window explicitly (e.g., 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z/PT1H) so billing joins don't guess windows from timestamps
Priya M: attribution: don't force token_breakdown in raw_usage. emit optional attribution_summary for sampled or heavy requests, deterministic sampling via hash(fingerprint)
Jonah L: big breakdowns should be offloaded. artifact_ref + artifact_size + artifact_hash in event; artifact service issues signed short-lived URLs
Tessa N: set auto-offload threshold at 6KB. event.meta.size_hint helps the ingest decide
Alex R: late-arrivals: raw_usage.status = accepted | late_arrival | reconciled. billing_adjustment has correction_reason and operator_id for audits
Priya M: fingerprint/edge_hmac algorithm and key rotation plan must be documented. include fingerprint_algo in event.meta
on
Jonah L: migration plan: publish schema_v2 opt-in, emit v2 for internal tenants, run v2->v1 compatibility proxy for external partners for 8w, compare ledgers for 2 billing cycles before cutover
Tessa N: testing: need transform harness that runs synthetic events through shim and asserts parity on aggregates (token totals, charge totals)
MeteringBot: checklist: publish-schema, deploy-shim, artifact-bucket, canary-dashboard, key-rotation-docs
Alex R: owners: Jonah -> shim + artifacts, Tessa -> test harness + canary dash, Priya -> docs + compatibility tests, Alex -> rollout coordination
Priya M: will add small example payload to RFC and schedule owners sync next Wed 10am
Jonah L: noted
Tessa N: :rocket:
